subject: Confirmation of Your Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are writing to confirm your recent flight booking from London to New York on September 15th. Your flight details are as follows: - Flight number: BA123 - Departure time: 10:00 AM - Seat: 23A Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The Airlines Team
